title: Decomposition of a finite index set into blocks
statement: For natural numbers $w,s$ and a finite set $T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,sw-1\}$, partition the indices into $s$ blocks of size $w$. In each block, take the offsets whose corresponding indices belong to $T$, and map those offsets back to their indices in that block; the union of these mapped subsets over all blocks is exactly $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite subset of the indices of a set of size $sw$
